items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Thomas move out the way' in the context of stage setup/clowning, and the interviewer asks about Kid Thomas's origin. There is no evidence of a personal, professional, or musical relationship between Joe Harris and Kid Thomas.

ctx.x: It's been a long time. Now you see this part here, when the band is not playing, that they had to elevate it like, you know, that goes in. Oh, yeah. For the flow show. Oh, yeah. Yeah, we move all of this and that goes in for the flow show. And Thomas move out the way and this goes right in. That's all the way out to the flow. See what Dave and them used to do that clowning there, they'd take the mic and go all the way to the end of this. Oh, yeah.
